note: Per-day slices of the combined-worksheet Blooket decks (FLASHCARD_DECK_SLICES_SPEC.md). Keyed by deck CSV, then by the OLD topic key (storage id, never printed). Each value is a list of inclusive [lo, hi] ranges over the CSV's Q# column (column 0); a card belongs to the topic whose ranges contain its Q#. Every valid card of a listed CSV belongs to exactly one topic (tests/blooket-deck-slices.test.js). Boundaries were placed by reading every stem on 2026-11-07; a combined deck NOT listed here is dealt whole (capped) and keeps the one-score-per-worksheet rule. Vendored byte-for-byte to roster-server/data/.
